name_input: THE KERALA MINERALS AND METALS LTD; THE KERALA MINERALS AND METALS LIMITED; KMML
export_evidence: kmml.com/marketing-network: "The marketing network of KMML is spread worldwide. KMML exports to different nations and has earned a two star rating as an exporting house. KMML's products are supplied to industries all over the globe, including countries like USA, Europe, Korea, UK, South Africa, Turkey, Mauritius, Dubai and Sri Lanka." — no dated bill-of-lading record, no destination/HS line, no B/L number was retrievable. importkey.com/countries/india/the-kerala-minerals-and-metals-ltd returned only a paywalled shell: "Join ImportKey to view the import and export data records of companies all over the world" — 0 shipment rows visible (counter: page claims 'Shipments available for THE KERALA MINERALS AND METALS LTD, refreshed daily', rows actually seen: 0). volza.com and eximpedia.app returned HTTP 403.
domestic_evidence: kmml.com/marketing-network: "Major customers in the domestic market are served directly by the company. KMML has an all India network of 14 stockists to meet requirements of our customers" — followed by a named stockist list (Surya Color Chem Bangalore, Manorama Sales Corporation Cochin, Sree Narayana Agencies Coimbatore, Sri Karthikeya Enterprises Hyderabad, Classic Solvents Mumbai, KEMCO Corporation Mumbai, Jagdish Chemicals Delhi, Neeru Marketing Delhi, Ceyenar Chemicals Telangana, Paul and Company Delhi, Vyas Rasayan Delhi, Bharti Chemicals Kolkata). This is a distribution-network listing, not a GST turnover figure, GeM/CPPP award or contract. No GST turnover band, no tender award and no annual-report sales split was readable: kmml.com/financials lists only PDF links ("Click Here For Details - Annual Report 2022-23") with no figures in the page text; kmml.com/tenders returned "Error 404".
note: State-owned producer ("A Government of Kerala Undertaking", Sankaramangalam, Chavara, Kollam, Kerala 691 583) and an integrated TiO2/beach-sand miner-manufacturer — role manufacturer, not a trader. Declared HS 282300 (titanium oxides) matches the actual product line (KEMOX rutile TiO2 pigment); 282739 and 320611 are plausible adjacent codes but were not verified against any shipment record. Per rule 5, the export claim is website self-declaration only: no dated customs/B-L entry with destination and B/L number could be opened on any free source (importkey paywalled, volza/eximpedia 403, web_search backend refused connections throughout the session), so export_status stays declared_only, not confirmed. Domestic side likewise rests on the stockist list, not on GST turnover or a public procurement award. Revenue and export volume: null — not public in readable form; the annual-report PDFs were not opened and no figure is invented here. No rejection grounds: entity is active and state-owned. HS codes should be treated as declared, not verified.
